learning_objective: 🎯 Understand the LIFO (Last-In-First-Out) linear data structure, its algorithmic operations, and real-world implementations like Polish notations and undo mechanisms.

key_vocabulary.definition: Last-In, First-Out: The principle governing stack operations where the most recently added item is removed first.
The operation of inserting a new element onto the top of the stack.
The operation of removing and returning the top-most element from the stack.
Inspecting the top-most element of the stack without removing it.
Underflow occurs when popping from an empty stack; Overflow occurs when pushing into a full stack (fixed-size).

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A stack behaves like a stack of plates: you can only add to the top (Push) and take from the top (Pop). In Python, lists easily implement stacks where `.append(item)` acts as push and `.pop()` acts as pop.

Stacks are critical for: 1) Evaluating arithmetic expressions (Postfix/Prefix), 2) Checking balanced parentheses in compilers, 3) Managing function calls in memory (Call Stack / Recursion), and 4) Implementing Undo/Redo features in software.

Infix (`A + B`) is readable by humans. Postfix/Reverse Polish Notation (`A B +`) and Prefix (`+ A B`) eliminate parentheses and operator precedence ambiguity for computers. Evaluating postfix using a stack: push operands, and when an operator appears, pop two operands, compute, and push the result back.

exam_tips: 📌 Always check if `len(stack) == 0` (or `not stack`) before calling `.pop()` in your Python code to prevent an IndexError (Underflow).
📌 In Postfix evaluation questions, remember operand order: the FIRST popped item is `op2` (right operand) and the SECOND popped item is `op1` (left operand). Compute `op1 operator op2`.
📌 Be ready to trace a stack step-by-step in a table format showing the contents of the stack after each Push/Pop operation.
quick_recap: ⭐ The top of the stack in a standard Python list implementation is always accessed at index `-1` (`stack[-1]`).
⭐ Stacks convert recursive algorithms into iterative ones by manually keeping track of state.
⭐ Postfix notation requires no parentheses because the order of operations is uniquely determined by operator placement.
